title: helenium ammophilum
intro: Helenium ammophilum, commonly known as Beach Sunflower or Seaside False Sunflower, is a perennial wildflower native to the coastal regions of North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Helenium ammophilum include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and protecting against oxidative stress. The plant's therapeutic actions may also include its potential to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, skin conditions, and respiratory problems due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.
